messages.content: You are an expert Windows D3D12 C++17 source generator. Respond exactly one JSON object with source and notes keys. No tools, no Markdown, no extra text.

Create standalone C++17 Windows source for an actual D3D12 cross-adapter shared buffer copy smoke test. Return one JSON object with exactly keys source (complete C++ source string) and notes (array of short strings). No Markdown fences. No tools or shell, no file reads/writes. Enumerate physical DXGI adapters, exclude software, choose two distinct adapter LUIDs, create devices and explicit copy queues. Allocate exactly 256KiB shared cross-adapter buffer using SHARED and SHARED_CROSS_ADAPTER heap flags, ALLOW_CROSS_ADAPTER resource flag, correct buffer/row-major layout, create/open shared handles across the devices. Producer upload buffer fills deterministic byte pattern and copies to shared buffer; publish producer completion through correctly created/opened shared cross-adapter fence; consumer waits on fence then copies shared buffer into local readback buffer and CPU verifies every byte. Correct resource states/transitions and separate devices ownership rules; no graphics windows or shaders needed. Check every HRESULT and wait return, bounded waits (10s max), cleanup handles via RAII. Print one-line JSON containing PASS or UNSUPPORTED or FAIL, adapter identities, bytes checked, reason, HRESULT where relevant. Fewer than 2 physical compatible devices or feature/resource incompatibility must return UNSUPPORTED, never PASS. Runtime verification mismatch returns FAIL/nonzero. Timing must be described as copy smoke only, no pooled-memory, peer-DMA, or throughput claims. Source should build with MSVC cl /std:c++17 /EHsc source.cpp /link d3d12.lib dxgi.lib. Include all headers, no CD3DX12 dependency, use WRL ComPtr. This source will be independently compiled/reviewed; accuracy matters more than optimistic compatibility. Do not generate a second variant or synthetic fallback.
